title: Supreme Court orders Centre to form panel to ensure State-wise uniformity in facilities for retired HC judges
description: The Supreme Court on Monday directed the Central government to constitute a committee to frame uniform guidelines for providing various facilities to retired High Court judges in India.A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana said that there was a lack of uniformity in facilities being provided to the judges in India.
